title: How Your Phone Vibrates Without Making Noise
hook: Watch this tiny motor spin inside.

script.narration: Watch this tiny motor spin inside.
script.visual_search: extreme macro close up of internal smartphone motherboard and tiny components

script.narration: Inside every smartphone is an eccentric rotating mass motor. It contains an intentionally off-center heavy weight attached to a tiny spinning shaft. When power applies, the weight spins rapidly, causing the entire device to shake violently.
script.visual_search: animation of small unbalanced weight spinning rapidly inside electronic device

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily science. Have you ever wondered how it fits? Watch this...

description:
Ever wonder how your phone vibrates when you get a text? Discover the clever mechanical secret inside your smartphone that creates silent alerts using physics and an off-center weight.

Learn amazing science and technology facts in under sixty seconds.
why_it_will_work: Answers a high-intent search query with a fascinating physical mechanism, matching our top-performing science and technology educational format.
